title.narrative: At least 35% of participating enterprises will have increased direct and/or indirect employment by at least 30% (Of these at least 35% will be women)

comment.narrative: Achieved / Exceeded by 49%. This is the average between EGs and SMEs. Between 2013 and 2017, 43% of EGs increased direct employment opportunities by over 30%. 59% of those were women owned. On the other hand, 30% of AREDP-supported SMEs increased direct employmen opportunities by 30% between 2015 and 2017, 44% of which were women owned (source: MIS).

title.narrative: At least 15% of project supported SMEs are female owned

comment.narrative: Exceeded by 33%. 800 SMEs were registered with AREDP, 74% of which were supported by the Project (593 SMEs). 121 SMEs were women owned (source: MIS).

title.narrative: Project management's development and accreditation of technical and professional service providers results in at least 20 project supported BDS service providers providing paidfor services

comment.narrative: Exceeded by 300%. 80 AREDP-supported SMEs were hired as BDSPs (source: MIS).

title.narrative: 25% of SG members have accessed and repaid loans

comment.narrative: Exceeded by 52%. Of the total of 81,880 SG members, 32,411 members took SG loans, and 30,790 repaid them (source: MIS).

title.narrative: At least 30% increase in direct/and or indirect employment

comment.narrative: Exceeded by 50%. A total of 13,918 rural men and women were directly employed by EGs and SMEs (source: MIS).

title.narrative: At least 40% of loan-able funds are in circulation at any given time

comment.narrative: Exceeded by 100%. Both SGs and VSLAs had 80% loanable funds (credit) in circulation (source: MIS)

title.narrative: 50% of the supported SMEs report increased net revenues

comment.narrative: Exceeded by 42%. 123 out of 173 surveyed SMEs reported an increase, 28% of which were women owned (source: 2016 SME Assessment).

title.narrative: 60% of Enterprise Groups (EGs) will have increased their net revenues by over 20%. At least 50% female.

comment.narrative: Exceeded by 43% /Exceeded by 30%. This represents the increase in annual net revenue between 2013 and 2017. Of 1,251 EGs active as of December 2017, 86% increased their net revenues by over 20%. 65% of those were women owned. (source: economic analysis)

title.narrative: At least 60% SGs and 80% VSLAs receive seed capital

comment.narrative: Achieved. Because many SGs could not open a bank account, seed capitals were provided to 92 SGs on pilot basis. The provision to SGs was never formalized. Of all 536 VSLAs formed, 455 matured VSLAs received seed capitals (about US$3.3 million in total). (source: MIS).
Exceeded by 20%. 81,880 rural men and women were mobilized by AREDP into SGs. The direct project beneficiaries are defined as the number of SG members (source: MIS).

title.narrative: At least 70% of viable SGs federate into VSLAs

comment.narrative: Exceeded by 27%. Out of 5,450 active SGs, 4,868 matured SGs were federated into VSLAs (source: MIS).

title.narrative: 80% of EGs supported by the Project will still be operating 2 years after start up. At least 35% will be female

comment.narrative: Achieved / Exceeded by 86%. 1,436 EGs out of the originally formed 1,768 EGs were active as of June 2018. 928 active EGs were women-owned (source: MIS).

title.narrative: At least 90% of project beneficiaries have access to financial services

comment.narrative: Achieved. All SG members gained access to savings and credit in target villages through SGs and VSLAs. About 40% of the members took loans. 60% of the borrowers were women (source: MIS).

title.narrative: VSLAs maintain at least 95% repayment rate on loans and at any given time have at least 60% of loanable funds

comment.narrative: Achieved. The target is to have at least 60% loanable funds. The end result at project closing indicated availability of 20% loanable funds. With 20% loanable funds available at VSLAs, 80% of the funds were in circulation for enterprise development (source: MIS).

title.narrative: All complaints received by Project and field staff are addressed within an established timeframe adn according to agreed standards

target.value: 98% of the complaints received are addressed

comment.narrative: Substantially achieved. AREDP received a total of 631 complaints, 98% of which were addressed. 25% of the complaints were related to financial and technical support, followed by salary payment (13%) and misbehavior (11%) (source: MIS).

title.narrative: Project management satisfactorily addresses the findings of the statutory audit conductd by the Auditor General for all IDA-fonanced/managed projects; and findings from an additional commercial audit

comment.narrative: Achieved (source: MIS).All audit findings were addressed within 3 months. All audit findings were addressed within 3 months.

title.narrative: Project management takes and records all necessary actions related to findings of regular monitoring, evaluation and learning reports

comment.narrative: Achieved. 85% of issues addressed (source: MIS).

title.narrative: Review of women-led SMEs completed, their challenges and needs identified

comment.narrative: Achieved (source: MIS).

title.narrative: Value chain and sub-sector analysis completed in key identified sector i.e. poultry, fisheries, handicraft

comment.narrative: Achieved. Handicraft, poultry, dairy, food processing, and agriculture value chains were studied (source: MIS).

title.narrative: Facilitating partners for social mobilization identified and procurement arrangements for them agreed between WB, MRRD and MoF

comment.narrative: Exceeded (source: MIS).

title.narrative: Assessment on cost effectiveness and technical capabilities of facilitating partners completed

comment.narrative: Exceeded. 14 potential facilitating partners for the follow-on project were assessed (source: MIS).

title.narrative: Facilitating partners for social mobilization identified and procurement arrangements for them agreed between WB, MRRD and MoF.

comment.narrative: Exceeded.

title.narrative: Provincial situation analysis completed for at least 5 provinces.

comment.narrative: Exceeded.

title.narrative: District situation analysis completed for new target provinces.

comment.narrative: Exceeded. Analyses were undertaken as part of provincial situation survey for all the 34 provinces, in which two to three districts were sampled (source: MIS).
